'''Imperial Corrections''' was an organization within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] under the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]] that oversaw the Empire's [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] and prisoner transfers. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Heedley]] was an officer in Imperial Corrections, and he oversaw the transfer&mdash;and later recovery&mdash;of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Vomba]], who escaped briefly in [[Mezenti Spaceport]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the transfer thanks to his pirate allies.
